_comment: APIDOC-1: the CURATED one-line summary per API route for the generated reference (tools/setup/New-PimApiReference.ps1), keyed 'METHOD /path' exactly as the reference prints it. Public text: plain language, what the route does for its caller -- no internal names, no customer names, never how a check works or what it does not check (no attack hints). A route without an entry is published as its method + path.
GET /api/active-assignments: The active and eligible PIM assignments right now, paged and filterable.
GET /api/drift: Where the tenant differs from the configuration (the last drift snapshot).
GET /api/approvals: The changes waiting for a second person.
POST /api/approvals/decide: Approve or deny one waiting change (never your own).
GET /api/search: Search admins, groups, roles and definitions.
GET /api/commit-status/{p1}: What happened to a commit, by its id.
